cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(aruco_interfaces)

# The message code must be generated by the Python that ROS was built with (/usr/bin/python3), not
# by the conda environment's Python, which lacks the code generator's libraries. Both are Python
# 3.12, so the generated code still works inside the conda environment.
set(Python3_EXECUTABLE /usr/bin/python3)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rosidl_default_generators REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)

rosidl_generate_interfaces(${PROJECT_NAME}
  "msg/ArucoMarker.msg"
  "msg/ArucoMarkerArray.msg"
  "msg/ParticleArray.msg"
  DEPENDENCIES geometry_msgs std_msgs
)

ament_package()
